title: NAACP Lawsuit Against xAI Data Center Moves Forward
excerpt: A judge has allowed a lawsuit brought by the NAACP against xAI regarding alleged data center pollution to proceed.
body_html:
A legal challenge brought by the NAACP against xAI is moving forward after a judge's ruling. The lawsuit accuses the artificial intelligence company of violating the Clean Air Act.

The legal action centers on concerns related to pollution from an xAI data center. The case will now continue through the judicial process as the allegations are examined further.
